sections.heading: Why Choose a Garage Floor Storm Shelter?
sections.html:
Garage floor storm shelters are an excellent choice for homeowners in Sherman and the wider North Texas area who seek unobtrusive, permanent storm protection. Unlike above-ground safe rooms that occupy floor space, these units are installed beneath your garage floor, making them virtually invisible when not in use. This means you can continue to use your garage as normal, parking vehicles directly over the shelter.

The convenience of having a shelter readily accessible in your garage cannot be overstated, especially during sudden severe weather. You can quickly move from your home to safety without exposure to the elements. These shelters are built with robust steel construction, sliding hatch doors for easy access, and ventilation systems to ensure comfort and safety during a storm.

For more options, explore our above-ground safe rooms or traditional underground storm shelters.

sections.heading: Our Garage Shelter Installation Process
sections.html:
Installing a garage floor storm shelter requires specialized skills and equipment to ensure structural integrity and proper drainage. Our experienced team handles every step with precision:

  • Site Assessment: We evaluate your garage slab and identify the optimal placement for your shelter, considering utility lines and foundation specifics.
  • Concrete Saw-Cutting: Our team uses professional-grade equipment to precisely cut and remove a section of your concrete garage floor.
  • Excavation: We carefully excavate the soil to the required depth, preparing the cavity for the shelter unit.
  • Shelter Placement: The pre-fabricated steel shelter is carefully lowered into the excavated space and leveled.
  • Anchoring and Backfill: The shelter is securely anchored, and the surrounding area is backfilled with concrete or gravel to ensure stability.
  • Concrete Finishing: We pour new concrete to fill the gap around the shelter, ensuring a seamless, flush finish with your existing garage floor.
  • Cleanup: We ensure all debris is removed, leaving your garage clean and ready for use.

We work efficiently to minimize disruption and complete your installation with the highest standards of craftsmanship. Learn more about typical storm shelter costs.

sections.heading: Meeting Life-Safety Standards for Your Protection
sections.html:
At Texoma Storm Shelters, your safety is our top priority. All our garage floor storm shelters are designed and installed to meet or exceed stringent national safety guidelines. We adhere to the specifications outlined in:

  • FEMA P-320: This publication provides detailed guidance for constructing safe rooms for tornado and hurricane protection. Our shelters are built to withstand extreme wind forces and flying debris.
  • ICC 500: The International Code Council (ICC) Standard for the Design and Construction of Storm Shelters offers comprehensive requirements for storm shelter performance. Our installations comply with these critical structural and occupant safety standards.

By choosing a shelter that meets these standards, you are investing in a proven, tested solution for life-safety. We ensure every aspect of your installation provides the maximum protection possible against severe weather events common in North Texas. For more details, read our guide on FEMA and ICC storm shelter standards.

faq.q: What is the typical cost for a garage floor storm shelter installation?
faq.a: The cost for a garage floor storm shelter installation in Sherman TX generally ranges from $4,800 to $7,900. This price includes the shelter unit, concrete saw-cutting, excavation, installation, and concrete finishing. Factors like shelter size and specific site conditions can affect the final estimate. We provide free written estimates to give you an accurate cost for your specific project.

faq.q: How long does it take to install a garage floor storm shelter?
faq.a: Most garage floor storm shelter installations can be completed within one to two days. This includes the time needed for concrete cutting, excavation, placing the shelter, and finishing the concrete. We work efficiently to minimize disruption to your home. We'll provide a clear timeline with your free written estimate.

faq.q: Can I really park my car over the shelter?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. Garage floor storm shelters are specifically designed to be flush-mounted into your concrete slab, allowing you to park your vehicle directly over them. The shelter's robust construction and the expert concrete finishing ensure it can safely support the weight of a standard vehicle without damage to the shelter or your garage floor.

faq.q: Do these shelters require any special maintenance?
faq.a: Garage floor storm shelters require very little maintenance. We recommend periodically checking the sliding door mechanism to ensure it operates smoothly and cleaning out any debris that might accumulate inside. Proper drainage is built into the installation to prevent water issues. Our team can provide specific maintenance tips upon installation.

faq.q: What sizes are available for garage floor storm shelters?
faq.a: Garage floor storm shelters come in various sizes to accommodate different family needs, typically ranging from 4-person to 12-person capacities. Common dimensions might include 4x6 feet, 5x7 feet, or larger. During your free consultation, we can discuss the best size for your family and garage space to ensure adequate protection.
